The same bundle has one unrelated or Summary-omitted live path.
The archive bundle is incomplete, historical-only, malformed, or manifest-mismatched.
The persisted no-active Status itself contains stale changed files or a nonzero count.
The archive bundle has been committed and the no-active worktree is clean.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use systematic root-cause debugging and red-green-refactor TDD; do not patch the generated Status marker to hide live changes.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The repair loop was reproduced and traced to generator/checker semantics before code changes; four red node IDs failed for the expected reasons, and the generator remains deterministic.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Derive post-archive ownership from the valid manifest-bound archived Summary changedFiles, not from broad path prefixes or Contract scope alone.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: transaction_owned_paths requires current index/receipt/pair/manifest, exact Contract and Summary SHA-256, schema v2 same-task Summary, and structured unique repository-relative changedFiles.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep arbitrary no-active live changes fail closed and emit remediation that the named command can actually perform.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Unowned live paths remain visible and explicitly state repair cannot establish ownership; unrelated, omitted, malformed, incomplete, historical, and digest-mismatched regressions pass.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve byte-for-byte Status on a failed repair attempt.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: repair_status refuses unowned paths before generation and restores original bytes or absence after generator or post-generation validation failure.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep English and Japanese lifecycle semantics aligned.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Cockpit READMEs and Status-reading references describe the same manifest/digest/Summary ownership boundary and repair limit in English and Japanese.

risk.detail: No-active ownership is a governance boundary. The implementation accepts only exact current digest-bound archive evidence and keeps every unowned path fail closed.

observedIssues.fact: After RFE-151 ai-finish, no-active Status correctly persisted zero transient changes, but consistency compared it with the governed implementation diff and recommended repair; repair regenerated the same marker and failed.
observedIssues.decision: Do not patch the marker or skip validation. Separate serialized Status drift from live ownership and derive the archive transition from immutable evidence.
observedIssues.resolution: Complete current archive transactions now own only paths named by their digest-bound archived Summary; unowned paths receive non-repair recovery guidance.
observedIssues.followUp: Require real post-ai-finish pre-commit validation, full quality, Hosted CI, and lifecycle closure.

observedIssues.fact: The four initial regressions proved old behavior rejected a complete Summary-owned diff, emitted false repair advice for a Summary-omitted path, and did not treat malformed evidence as a complete failure boundary.
observedIssues.decision: Implement one evidence classifier and one diagnostic split rather than adding path-prefix exceptions.
observedIssues.resolution: All 131 focused Status/archive regressions pass after the minimal classifier and repair changes.
observedIssues.followUp: Retain exact node IDs in Contract and Summary scenario coverage.

observedIssues.fact: Review found that path-only manifest validation would allow modified Summary bytes to expand temporary ownership.
observedIssues.decision: Bind ownership to the manifest's exact Contract and Summary SHA-256 values and require schema v2 structured changedFiles.
observedIssues.resolution: Bad Contract/Summary digest, malformed changedFiles, duplicate/invalid paths, and mismatched identities grant no ownership.
observedIssues.followUp: Full quality and provider CI must exercise the strengthened negative matrix.

residualRisks.detail: The exception verifies repository evidence at command time but does not claim crash-atomicity across later commit operations; rerunning recomputes the complete current change set.
